description: TOC entry whose key has bit 31 set, pointing at a string record that names it
notes: The second TOC entry's key word is 0x80000000 | offset-of-'com.example.custom'. A reader that misses bit 31 sees a nonsense two-billion key that matches nothing. The value is an array of two references to the SAME dictionary record, which is legal sharing rather than a cycle: it must parse, not trip the depth limit.
